info.name: NG Backup
info.summary: Encrypted, incremental backups of your Nextcloud — files, database and config — with restore from the web interface
info.description:
Back up your whole Nextcloud — data directory, database and configuration — encrypted and incremental, to storage you choose. Restore single files, folders, a user, or the whole server from the web interface or `occ`. No shell access or external tools needed, so it also runs on Nextcloud All-in-One and hosted Nextcloud.
**Where to** - S3 and S3-compatible storage, SFTP, WebDAV, SMB, FTP, Swift or a local path (NFS mount), through the connection code of the External storage app. A location is never mounted and never shows up in Files.
**How** - Deduplicated, compressed and encrypted (XChaCha20-Poly1305) on the server before upload, streamed straight to the location: no local copy, no double disk space. Unchanged files are not read again. - Database dump through Nextcloud's own connection, in one consistent transaction (PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite). - Runs in short steps from the background jobs, so a server or container restart does not lose a running backup. - Daily schedule, retention policy, and `occ backup:verify` (optionally `--deep`) to check that a backup can be read.
**Safe** - Up to three passphrases plus a recovery kit; the passphrase is the actual key. - Deletion delay and append-only locations against ransomware or a compromised server; S3 object lock supported. - Admin notifications on failures, stale backups and changes to keys and locations.
**Restore** - Files and folders into a new folder, merged, or replacing the original — through Nextcloud, so overwritten files keep a version and removed ones go to the trash. - One user (account, files, calendars, contacts) via user_migration. - The whole server onto a fresh installation (disaster recovery).
NG Backup needs Nextcloud's background jobs on system cron (a real cron line, not only the setting). Read "Known limitations" in the README before you rely on it, and test a restore. Feedback is very welcome: use the "Share your experience" link on the admin page.
If you like NG Backup, don't forget to give the app a star in the app store and the [repository](https://github.com/dillardblom/ng_backup) a star on GitHub!
Developed and sponsored by [Ensembia](https://www.ensembia.com). We can offer (paid) assistance if you need help with restoring a backup after a crash.
